RocksDB column-family init, iteration, slot lookup, copy, and insert helpers.

# Purpose
This file provides a C wrapper around a RocksDB database that uses multiple column families. It defines functions to open an existing database in read-only mode with [`fd_rocksdb_init`](<#fd_rocksdb_init>), create a new database with [`fd_rocksdb_new`](<#fd_rocksdb_new>), and release all RocksDB resources with [`fd_rocksdb_destroy`](<#fd_rocksdb_destroy>). The code sets up the column family names used by the database, such as `default`, `meta`, `root`, `transaction_status`, and `address_signatures`, and it stores the RocksDB handles and options inside `fd_rocksdb_t`.

The file also provides helper functions for slot-based access to data stored in the `root` and `meta` column families. Functions such as [`fd_rocksdb_first_slot`](<#fd_rocksdb_first_slot>), [`fd_rocksdb_last_slot`](<#fd_rocksdb_last_slot>), [`fd_rocksdb_get_meta`](<#fd_rocksdb_get_meta>), and the `fd_rocksdb_root_iter_*` functions read slot metadata and iterate through root entries. Other helpers, such as [`fd_rocksdb_get_slot`](<#fd_rocksdb_get_slot>), [`fd_rocksdb_iter_seek_to_slot_if_possible`](<#fd_rocksdb_iter_seek_to_slot_if_possible>), [`fd_rocksdb_copy_over_slot_indexed_range`](<#fd_rocksdb_copy_over_slot_indexed_range>), and [`fd_rocksdb_insert_entry`](<#fd_rocksdb_insert_entry>), support key parsing, iterator positioning, range copy between databases, and entry insertion. The file acts as an internal database access layer for code that needs to read, scan, and copy RocksDB data by slot and column family.
